title: Axiom Math · general number-field zero-free half-plane at 31/32
description: Axiom Math’s general-family theorem: for every number field K, the Dedekind zeta function has no zeros in Re(s) > 31/32 away from its pole at s = 1. Its finite-order Hecke corollary applies over every number field and includes s = 1 for nonprincipal characters. Dean Cureton and Jesse Thorner directed the research and made the mathematical judgments; AxiomProver generated proofs and formalization. The actual native proof closure is retained from AxiomMath/DedekindZetaZeroFree at 09afbb4ce6570c1615d58509dc197fc9f0956b7d, with module import paths relocated and original declaration namespaces retained. The native Lean 4.35.0-rc3 / Mathlib 0493595 toolchain and the general-family target differ from the tracker’s Lean 4.34.1 / Mathlib d13f23b all-Dirichlet contract. This draft preserves the genuine general theorem; The intended tracker target is the all-Dirichlet specialization obtained from the Hecke theorem over Q. Its formal character/L-function identification and toolchain integration remain pending. No tracker acceptance or current-record improvement is claimed. The proof adapts material from OpenAI/math, Tau Ceti, LeanPool and the vendored class-field-theory development, retaining original attribution and licenses. The historical source repository was created on 12 October 2026 at 18:06:30 UTC; its date is used for this imported submission.
